📷 Attention Wildlife Photographers! 

Have you ever wondered what it would be like to have one of your images published in a magazine?

The feeling of having your work in a magazine for wildlife photographers that you can show off to your friends and other wildlife photographers?

That's exactly what happens to the winners and runners-up of our monthly photo contests. 

Each month the Journal of Wildlife Photography hosts a themed photo contest in two categories Beginner and Advanced (Intermediate Category to come in December) where our members can compete with other photographers of their skill level for a chance to win cash prizes, get published in our magazine, get your images shared on all of our social platforms, and get your images in front of 90,000 subscribers!

Why participate?
🌍 Showcase your talent and passion for wildlife photography.
💰 Stand a chance to win a $250 cash prize and $2,000 in the year-end contest starting December 1st.
🐾 Contribute to wildlife conservation awareness through your art.
🤝 Join a community of wildlife photography enthusiasts.

Prizes:
🥇 Advanced Category: $250 Cash.
🥇 Beginner Category: $250 Cash.
🥇 Intermediate Category coming in December.

Check out the images from some of our recent Advanced and Beginner category winners.

If you'd like to participate, use the link below: https://journalofwildlifephotography.com/wildlife-photography-contest/
